LESSON: READING 7.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: When do we use interjections in sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify interjections in texts for comprehension
2. use interjections in oral paragraphs for expression
3. appreciate the role of interjections in expressing emotion in communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension

Teach
• Focus skill: identify interjections in texts for comprehension.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. When do we use interjections in sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
